I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM.

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Text messages telling drivers which bay to use weren't reaching them when they checked in at the Eau Claire gatehouse, at Dock Doors 14–18 on the 04:00 shift. Support patched it on 4 Oct 2025, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift got through the gate without help. The note also lists it as a 6 Oct action item to archive the kiosk logs.

2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support to test the scanner firmware. The note has no date, so I can't say when this was current.

Moss's other notes have no ticket numbers for this account. Those are the 14 Sep 2025 North pipeline digest, the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in and the two Central team digests. I left out Quarendon Freightways (one "r"), which the cheat sheet says is a different company and not a customer.

Two other QFL tickets show up outside Moss's notes: SUP-4471, the November 2025 Sev 1 outage, and #4912 on the account page. I told you about them and offered to add them as a separate list for the weekly notes.
